facts.one_line_description: Provides oncology management software and services to help health plans and employers deliver better cancer care while reducing costs
stated_value_props: Delivers measurable savings without compromising care
Purpose-built oncology platform that eliminates administrative friction
Proactive, whole-person guidance at every step
Industry's first integrated oncology management solution
Powered by nation's first oncology focused 50-state virtual medical group
Reduces physical, mental, and financial toll of cancer
recent_themes: Supportive care as core oncology infrastructure
Integrated mental health and behavioral health services
facts.tone_signals: Professional, empathetic, expert-driven, patient-centric, evidence-based, collaborative with emphasis on measurable outcomes and clinical expertise

icp.icp_reasoning: OncoHealth operates a 50-state virtual medical group serving 15M members across 22 health plans. Strong provider network signal (94% provider satisfaction, portal platform) and scale, but oncology specialty focus is narrower than broad network credentialing needs. High buying readiness given multi-state licensing complexity.

industry_fit.rationale: Digital health platform serving health plans with clinical delivery (oncology care management, 24/7 nursing, virtual medical group) — strong target vertical.

scale_signals.rationale: 15M members supported across 22 health plan partners and 4K employers; $240M in customer savings demonstrates enterprise-scale operations.

provider_network_signal.rationale: Operates nation's first oncology-focused 50-state virtual medical group with 94% provider satisfaction and provider portal platform — core network operations.

growth_maturity.rationale: Established with 22 health plan partnerships and URAC/NCQA certifications; evidence of scale but limited hyper-growth signals in hiring or funding.

buying_readiness.rationale: Platform messaging emphasizes eliminating administrative friction and collaborative provider relationships; no explicit credentialing/licensing pain stated.

intent_themes.theme: Multi-state provider licensing and credentialing automation
Provider network management and operational efficiency
Administrative friction reduction in provider workflows
Provider portal and data integration infrastructure
Compliance and accreditation maintenance across states

pain_points.pain: Managing provider licensing and credentialing across 50 states for virtual medical group
pain_points.evidence: Stated value prop: 'Powered by nation's first oncology focused 50-state virtual medical group' — implies complex multi-state licensing burden.

pain_points.pain: Administrative friction in provider-facing platform and workflows
pain_points.evidence: Value prop explicitly mentions 'Purpose-built oncology platform that eliminates administrative friction' and maintains provider portal platform.

pain_points.pain: Maintaining high provider satisfaction while scaling network operations
pain_points.evidence: 94% provider satisfaction metric is highlighted as social proof — suggests provider experience is critical success metric they actively manage.

pain_points.pain: Ensuring continuous compliance for URAC and NCQA certifications across provider network
pain_points.evidence: URAC Accredited 2027 and NCQA certified status requires ongoing provider credentialing and compliance validation.

pain_points.pain: Scaling oncology provider network to support 22 health plan partnerships and 4K employers
pain_points.evidence: 22 Health Plan Partners and 15M Members Supported indicates need for efficient provider onboarding and network growth infrastructure.

missing_data: Recent funding rounds or growth capital events
Current hiring velocity in provider operations or network management roles
Explicit pain points around credentialing timelines or licensing delays
Technology stack details for provider data management
Rate of new provider additions to network
Specific oncology specialties and subspecialties requiring credentialing

copy.hero_headline: Credentialing infrastructure for oncology networks that span 50 states
copy.subheadline: OncoHealth manages 15M members across 22 health plans with a virtual medical group in every state. CertifyOS keeps your provider licensing, credentialing, and compliance current without the manual load.
copy.value_prop_one_liner: One system that automates multi-state licensing, credentialing, and URAC/NCQA compliance for specialty care networks at scale.
copy.pain_paragraph: When you're running the nation's first 50-state oncology virtual medical group, provider credentialing and state licensing aren't one-time tasks. They're continuous, state-specific, and critical to maintaining your 94% provider satisfaction and accreditation status. Manual tracking doesn't scale with 22 health plan partners and 4K employers counting on you.

cta_primary.text: See how it works for oncology networks
